scope: Seven explicit release gate clauses reviewed now; not the full54-roadmap/15-user audit or a completion percentage

requirements.requirement: `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo check --workspace --all-targets`, `cargo test --workspace` and strict workspace Clippy pass.
requirements.classification: proved current exact-source Linux/Windows hosted workspace format/check/test/strict-lint scope
evidence: CI41639409624: Windows Cargo test completed13:33:25Z and strict workspace Clippy13:33:52Z; Linux verify passed
requirements.limits: Overall hosted job still completing its release build; no whole-roadmap acceptance inferred.

requirements.requirement: Linux and Windows CI pass for the release commit.
requirements.classification: proved exact-source Linux/Windows CI: four successful jobs

requirements.requirement: Rebuilt artifact checksums verify and archive inspection finds the expected app, indexer, helper, policies, assets and documentation.
requirements.classification: proved published content and post-publication checksum scope
requirements.limits: Content/identity inspection does not replace functional acceptance outside the recorded native scope.

requirements.requirement: `README.md`, `USER_GUIDE.md`, `ROADMAP.md` and `RELEASE_NOTES.md` agree with the exact artifacts.
requirements.classification: proved current repository delivery-document reconciliation; packaged delivery snapshot explicit
requirements.limits: Generated SOURCE_REVISION identifies packaged source; packaged documents are build-time snapshots. Historical paragraphs are not current acceptance claims.

requirements.requirement: Version, artifact names, checksums and generated release notes agree.
requirements.classification: proved current local artifact names/version/checksums and repository delivery notes

requirements.requirement: Linux signatures and all artifact checksums verify after download; unsigned Windows direct downloads are labeled explicitly.
requirements.classification: owner signing identity wait plus independent software/delivery checks
requirements.limits: All seven local post-publication artifact checksums verify. Production Linux signatures remain an owner-identity/key wait; unsigned Windows direct preview is explicitly documented.

requirements.requirement: David reviews the release notes and any remaining known limitations. No blocker is waived without a written decision.
requirements.limits: Never inferred from automated/native test totals; remaining software work continues.
